text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Greek Cypriot press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Premeditated murder charges can be substantiated against five Turks involved in shooting of Solomos Solomos.
- Chicago-style escape of two Israelis in central Nicosia yesterday. They got into the occupied areas but they sent them back.
- President Glafcos Clerides diplomatically rejects possibility of meeting with Turkish Cypriot leader Rauf Denktash.
- Guns and ammunition is found at Limassol port.
- Free Democrats movement president George Vassiliou calls for Clerides-Denktash joint statement to defuse tension.
- Communist Akel party chief Demetris Christofias tells the United States to put pressure on Turkey and Denktash for a solution.
- Clerides will not be issuing a joint statement, or be meeting Denktash.
- Proposal is being mooted for retirement from civil service at 63.
- The Attorney-general is ready to press charges against five people holding key positions in the pseudo-state.
